rv.q: Nicole Travolta is a charming personality who holds your attention with her unique story.
With her trusty spray tan gun and celebrity impersonations, Nicole Travolta’s confessional comedy show is doing pretty well.
By the show’s end, Travolta emerges as a figure of hard-won resilience, transforming missteps into material and self-reckoning into art.

In Nicole Travolta Alright, actor and comedienne Nicole Travolta does exactly that, crafting a fast-moving, brutally honest solo show that leans into her chaos with humor, candor, and surprising control.

cn.t: Nicole Travolta delivers a compelling, brutally honest solo show that transforms personal chaos into sharp comedy. Critics praise her dazzling performance blending stand-up and storytelling, proving she's more than just a famous last name.
